1. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and flange member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler, wherein the composite fabric is __applied after the first, second and third members are joined together__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric, wherein the adhesive is __a structural adhesive applied as a discrete layer distinct from any resin contained within the laminated composite tape__.

2. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the fabric layer covers the radius areas, and __the composite fabric layer is applied to the radius areas after the void is formed__.

3. (Original) [Claim 3 text not provided in application; status cannot be determined]

5. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas, and __the adhesive is applied as a separate structural adhesive layer distinct from adhesive constituents of the laminated composite tape__.

6. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other, and __the offset is created by intentional placement of the fabric layers rather than by wrinkles or deformation during manufacturing__.

7. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base, wherein the composite fabric is __applied after the channels and base are joined together__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer, wherein the adhesive is __a structural adhesive applied as a discrete layer distinct from any resin contained within the composite channels and base__.

12. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes __at least__ three composite patches respectively on each of the channels and the base, and __the patches are positioned and sized to cover only the radius filler zones__.

13. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler, and __the structural adhesive sheet is a pre-formed adhesive film applied separately from the manufacturing of the channels and base__.

14. (Original) [Claim 14 text not provided in application; status cannot be determined]

15. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the channels are __formed as C-shaped members and the base is a flat plate member, and the composite fabric and structural adhesive are applied after assembly of the channels and base into the I-section structure__.

25. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape including a web and flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a cap and a base, each including radius areas between the web and the flanges and between the cap and base, the cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the I-section structure defining the radius filler zone, wherein the composite fabric is __applied after the cap and base are joined to the I-section structure__; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and a layer of structural adhesive surrounding and joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone, wherein the structural adhesive is __applied as a discrete layer distinct from any resin contained within the laminated composite tape of the I-section structure, cap, and base__.
